Name: TENTATIVE_PLAYER_PARAM_ST
Description: Player movement, camera, lock-on, guard, ricochet and LookAt tuning values that apply to the player's AC as a whole. Many fields are provisional or left over from development; several are marked as disabled.

Fields.Name: Player Automatic Foot Effect SFX Identifier
Fields.Description: Identifier used for foot effect SFX IDs. Corresponds to the ZZZ portion of the XYYZZZ SFX ID.

Fields.Name: Movement Direction Step Angle
Fields.Description: The pad input direction is snapped to steps of this angle. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Movement Control Gravity
Fields.Description: Gravitational acceleration used by movement control. In metres per second squared.

Fields.Name: High-Speed Brake Start Speed
Fields.Description: At or above this speed, the condition for entering the high-speed brake character state is met. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Boost Re-Fire Speed
Fields.Description: When the speed in the acceleration direction reaches this value or more, the condition for re-firing the boost is met. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Brake Start Speed
Fields.Description: At or above this speed, the condition for entering the brake character state is met. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Brake End Speed
Fields.Description: At or below this speed, the condition for leaving the brake character state is met. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Landing Stiffness Height Threshold
Fields.Description: If the highest point reached after leaving the ground is this height or lower, no landing stiffness is triggered. In metres.

Fields.Name: 90-Degree Turn Start Angle
Fields.Description: When the angle between the character's facing and the pad direction is this value or more, the condition for a 90-degree turn is met. In degrees.

Fields.Name: 180-Degree Turn Start Angle
Fields.Description: When the angle between the character's facing and the pad direction is this value or more, the condition for a 180-degree turn is met. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Boost Speed Rate: Sideways
Fields.Description: Top speed while boosting sideways and shooting, as a percentage.

Fields.Name: Boost Speed Rate: Backwards
Fields.Description: Top speed while boosting backwards and shooting, as a percentage.

Fields.Name: Boost Acceleration Rate: Sideways
Fields.Description: Acceleration while boosting sideways and shooting, as a percentage.

Fields.Name: Boost Acceleration Rate: Backwards
Fields.Description: Acceleration while boosting backwards and shooting, as a percentage.

Fields.Name: Boost Slowdown Direction Angle
Fields.Description: When boosting sideways or backwards at this angle or more from the front, the movement counts as slowed down. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Look Target: Left Turn Angle at Start
Fields.Description: When a turn to face forward starts, an angle difference to the front of this value or less turns left. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Look Target: Right Turn Angle at Start
Fields.Description: When a turn to face forward starts, an angle difference to the front of this value or more turns right. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Look Target: Left Turn Angle While Turning
Fields.Description: While turning to face forward, an angle difference to the front of this value or less turns left. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Look Target: Right Turn Angle While Turning
Fields.Description: While turning to face forward, an angle difference to the front of this value or more turns right. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Look Target: Large Left Turn Angle at Start
Fields.Description: Large-turn variant: when a turn to face forward starts, an angle difference to the front of this value or less turns left. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Look Target: Large Right Turn Angle at Start
Fields.Description: Large-turn variant: when a turn to face forward starts, an angle difference to the front of this value or more turns right. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Lock: Horizontal Lock Range Screen Ratio
Fields.Description: Normal lock. Shrinks the horizontal lock range to this fraction of the view. While in use, the lock range after defeating an enemy is disabled. Set to 1 to leave the range unchanged.

Fields.Name: Lock: Vertical Lock Range Screen Ratio
Fields.Description: Normal lock. Shrinks the vertical lock range to this fraction of the view. While in use, the lock range after defeating an enemy is disabled. Set to 1 to leave the range unchanged.

Fields.Name: Boost Switchback Angle
Fields.Description: While boosting, the angle between input direction and movement direction at which the switchback brake applies. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Quad Leg Hover Switchback Angle
Fields.Description: While hovering on quad legs, the angle between input direction and movement direction at which the switchback brake applies. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Player Glide Foot Effect SFX Identifier
Fields.Description: Identifier used for the foot effect particle IDs while gliding. Corresponds to the ZZZ portion of the XYYZZZ particle ID.

Fields.Name: Delayed Turn: Maximum Turn Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum turning speed of the model during a delayed turn. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Lock: Unlock on Passing Angle
Fields.Description: Normal lock. Angle on one side used to release the lock when passing the target. At 180, the release-on-passing feature is OFF. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Lock: Look Target Offset Interpolation Speed
Fields.Description: Normal lock. Interpolation speed of the look target offset, used for semi-auto lock. In radians per second.

Fields.Name: Lock: Semi-Auto Free Camera Offset Time
Fields.Description: Normal lock, free camera during semi-auto lock. When the right stick is held for longer than this, the offset starts returning to the centre. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Camera: Auto Pull-Back Return Rate (Vertical)
Fields.Description: When the AC leaves the screen the camera pulls back automatically. Vertical interpolation rate used when it returns (0.0 to 1.0). Only applies to the distance pulled back automatically.

Fields.Name: Lock: Previous Auto-Sighting Target Block Time
Fields.Description: Normal lock. During semi-auto lock, for this long after the right stick is pushed, the previous auto-sighting target cannot be locked onto. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Booster Locomotion Return Time
Fields.Description: Boosters rotate when a TAE event plays a thruster particle effect. Interpolation time for them to return to their default direction after the TAE ends. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Camera: Free Camera Focus Point Max Distance
Fields.Description: Maximum distance of the focus point in free camera. The focus point is where a ray from the camera hits, or the point at this distance if it hits nothing. The camera may rotate around it when pulling back. In metres.

Fields.Name: Camera: Auto Pull-Back Max Distance
Fields.Description: Maximum distance the camera pulls back automatically when the AC leaves the screen. Wall collisions take priority. In metres.

Fields.Name: Camera: Auto Pull-Back Margin (Horizontal)
Fields.Description: Horizontal margin for the automatic pull-back when the AC leaves the screen (0.0 to 1.0). 0.0: pull back until the AC just stays at the screen edge. 1.0: pull back until the AC is at the screen centre.

Fields.Name: Camera: Auto Pull-Back Return Rate (Horizontal)
Fields.Description: When the AC leaves the screen the camera pulls back automatically. Horizontal interpolation rate used when it returns (0.0 to 1.0). Only applies to the distance pulled back automatically.

Fields.Name: Shield Charge Hold Time
Fields.Description: Holding Quick Boost for this long also counts as pressing the shield charge button. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Stamina Loss Fixed Reduction: Normal Guard
Fields.Description: Disabled. Fixed amount subtracted from the stamina loss on a normal guard.

Fields.Name: Stamina Loss Multiplier: Normal Guard
Fields.Description: Disabled. Multiplier applied to the stamina loss on a normal guard.

Fields.Name: Stamina Loss Fixed Reduction: Strong Guard
Fields.Description: Disabled. Fixed amount subtracted from the stamina loss on a strong guard.

Fields.Name: Stamina Loss Multiplier: Strong Guard
Fields.Description: Disabled. Multiplier applied to the stamina loss on a strong guard.

Fields.Name: Stamina Loss Fixed Reduction: Shield Barrier
Fields.Description: Fixed amount subtracted from the stamina loss when the shield barrier is hit.

Fields.Name: Stamina Loss Multiplier: Shield Barrier
Fields.Description: Multiplier applied to the stamina loss when the shield barrier is hit.

Fields.Name: Dash Stamina: Maximum
Fields.Description: Maximum dash stamina.

Fields.Name: Dash Stamina: Recovery per Second
Fields.Description: Dash stamina recovered per second.

Fields.Name: Dash Stamina: Drain per Second
Fields.Description: Dash stamina consumed per second.

Fields.Name: ChrAct Falling Speed Threshold
Fields.Description: A downward speed of this value or more meets the ChrAct "considered falling" condition. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Dash Stamina: Cooldown
Fields.Description: Time after a dash before the next dash is possible. Also the time before dash stamina starts recovering. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Flight Altitude Limit
Fields.Description: Maximum flight altitude. In metres.

Fields.Name: Aim Mode: Target Search Ray Distance
Fields.Description: Raycast distance used to search for targets in view while in aim mode.

Fields.Name: Altitude Jump: Middle Pad Tilt
Fields.Description: Altitude-specified jump. Pad tilt treated as the middle angle when the jump starts.

Fields.Name: Altitude Jump: Maximum Pad Tilt
Fields.Description: Altitude-specified jump. Pad tilt treated as the maximum angle when the jump starts.

Fields.Name: Wall Jump: Toward-Wall Pad Angle
Fields.Description: Wall jump. Pad direction angle difference within which the input counts as moving toward the wall. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Wall Jump: Middle Pad Angle
Fields.Description: Wall jump. Pad direction angle difference treated as the middle angle when choosing the jump direction. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Wall Jump: Maximum Pad Angle
Fields.Description: Wall jump. Pad direction angle difference treated as the maximum angle when choosing the jump direction. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Falling Throw Activation Speed
Fields.Description: A falling throw can be triggered while falling at this speed or more. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Free Fall Brake Start Speed
Fields.Description: Speed at which braking starts during free fall. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Free Fall Maximum Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum speed during free fall. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Propeller: Free Fall Brake Start Speed
Fields.Description: Speed at which braking starts during free fall with propeller parts. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Propeller: Free Fall Maximum Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum free fall speed with propeller parts. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Stability Base Value
Fields.Description: Base stability value of the player's AC.

Fields.Name: Run Delayed Release Time
Fields.Description: When ChrBehavior uses the "run (delayed release)" pad input, running counts as released this long after the input is released. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Walk to Run Pad Tilt
Fields.Description: When the pad tilt is this value or more, the condition for the run state is met. 1 is full tilt.

Fields.Name: Shooting Action Lock Camera Param ID
Fields.Description: Lock camera param ID used during shooting actions.

Fields.Name: Shooting Action Rumble ID
Fields.Description: Rumble ID used during shooting actions.

Fields.Name: Turn Brake
Fields.Description: Maximum brake applied when the AC's facing and the acceleration direction (pad input direction) differ. In metres per second squared.

Fields.Name: Turn Brake: Minimum Angle
Fields.Description: The turn brake starts to apply when the facing and the acceleration direction differ by this angle or more. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Turn Brake: Maximum Angle
Fields.Description: The full turn brake applies when the facing and the acceleration direction differ by this angle or more. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Turn Brake: Minimum Speed
Fields.Description: Below this speed the turn brake does not apply. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Turn Brake: Minimum Brake Rate
Fields.Description: Once the minimum angle is exceeded, the brake rate starts from this value.

Fields.Name: Lock: Keep Lock When Target Hidden
Fields.Description: How long the lock is kept after the lock target is blocked by a wall. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Quick Boost Lock Camera Param ID
Fields.Description: Lock camera param ID used during Quick Boost actions.

Fields.Name: Camera: Horizontal Move Start Angle
Fields.Description: When the AC moves left or right on screen, the angle from the centre before the camera starts moving horizontally. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Camera: Character Follow Rate
Fields.Description: Rate at which the camera focus point follows the character in normal use (0.0 to 1.0). Lower values follow more slowly.

Fields.Name: Camera: Lock Camera Param Interpolation Rate
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate used when the camera param ID changes (0.0 to 1.0). Lower values change more slowly.

Fields.Name: Camera: Z Tilt Start Sideways Speed
Fields.Description: When the AC's sideways (X) speed relative to the camera is this value or more, the camera starts to tilt. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Camera: Z Tilt Maximum Sideways Speed
Fields.Description: When the AC's sideways (X) speed relative to the camera is this value or more, the camera tilts fully. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Camera: Z Tilt Maximum Angle
Fields.Description: Camera roll angle at full tilt. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Camera: Z Tilt Interpolation Frames
Fields.Description: Interpolation frames while tilting the camera. The target angle is reached after this many frames.

Fields.Name: Camera: Z Tilt End Interpolation Frames
Fields.Description: Interpolation frames while returning the camera tilt. The target angle is reached after this many frames.

Fields.Name: Camera: Quick Turn Rotation Speed Rate
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the camera's XY rotation speed during a quick turn, as a percentage.

Fields.Name: Camera: Rotation Speed Minimum
Fields.Description: Minimum camera speed when turning the camera slowly sideways. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Camera: Rotation Speed Maximum
Fields.Description: Maximum camera speed when turning the camera slowly sideways. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Camera: Fast Rotation Speed Minimum
Fields.Description: Minimum camera speed when turning the camera sharply sideways. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Camera: Fast Rotation Speed Maximum
Fields.Description: Maximum camera speed when turning the camera sharply sideways. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Guard: Passive Guard Performance Rate
Fields.Description: Guard performance rate during a passive guard.

Fields.Name: Camera: Blade Homing Up Angle
Fields.Description: For blade homing, the camera counts as facing up when it points up by this angle or more. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Camera: Blade Homing Down Angle
Fields.Description: For blade homing, the camera counts as facing down when it points down by this angle or more. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Camera: Over-Shoulder View Always Left
Fields.Description: Whether the over-the-shoulder view always shifts to the left. 1: always left. 0: whichever side is nearer.

Fields.Name: Jump: Max Speed Input Time
Fields.Description: Holding the jump input for this long gives the maximum jump power. In seconds.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Waist Turn Performance
Fields.Description: Turning performance of the waist for LookAt. In percent per second.

Fields.Name: Tank Additive Move Anim: Minimum Acceleration
Fields.Description: Tank legs additive movement animation plays when acceleration is this value or more and the acceleration change condition is also met. In metres per second squared.

Fields.Name: Tank Additive Move Anim: Acceleration Change
Fields.Description: Tank legs additive movement animation plays when acceleration changes by this value or more and the minimum acceleration condition is also met. In metres per second squared.

Fields.Name: AI: Last Navi Volume Position Update Distance
Fields.Description: The stored last position inside a navigation volume is updated once the AC moves this far from it. In metres.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Arm Turn Performance
Fields.Description: Turning performance of the arms for LookAt. In percent per second.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Left Clavicle Rate
Fields.Description: LookAt correction rate for the left shoulder (clavicle). 0.0 to 1.0.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Left Clavicle Lower Limit
Fields.Description: Lower angle limit of the left shoulder (clavicle) for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Left Clavicle Upper Limit
Fields.Description: Upper angle limit of the left shoulder (clavicle) for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Left Upper Arm Rate
Fields.Description: LookAt correction rate for the left upper arm. 0.0 to 1.0.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Left Upper Arm Left Limit
Fields.Description: Left-side angle limit of the left upper arm for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Left Upper Arm Right Limit
Fields.Description: Right-side angle limit of the left upper arm for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Left Hand Rate
Fields.Description: LookAt correction rate for the left hand. 0.0 to 1.0.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Left Hand Lower Limit
Fields.Description: Lower angle limit of the left hand for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Left Hand Upper Limit
Fields.Description: Upper angle limit of the left hand for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Right Clavicle Rate
Fields.Description: LookAt correction rate for the right shoulder (clavicle). 0.0 to 1.0.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Right Clavicle Lower Limit
Fields.Description: Lower angle limit of the right shoulder (clavicle) for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Right Clavicle Upper Limit
Fields.Description: Upper angle limit of the right shoulder (clavicle) for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Right Upper Arm Rate
Fields.Description: LookAt correction rate for the right upper arm. 0.0 to 1.0.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Right Upper Arm Left Limit
Fields.Description: Left-side angle limit of the right upper arm for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Right Upper Arm Right Limit
Fields.Description: Right-side angle limit of the right upper arm for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Right Hand Rate
Fields.Description: LookAt correction rate for the right hand. 0.0 to 1.0.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Right Hand Lower Limit
Fields.Description: Lower angle limit of the right hand for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: LookAt: Right Hand Upper Limit
Fields.Description: Upper angle limit of the right hand for LookAt. -180 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: Propeller: Control Interpolation Rate
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate of the control used with propeller parts.

Fields.Name: Knockback: Multi-Hit Interval
Fields.Description: After a knockback, if the same damage keeps hitting, another knockback occurs after this time. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Knockback: Normal Guard Distance Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier on knockback distance during a normal guard.

Fields.Name: Knockback: Strong Guard Distance Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier on knockback distance during a strong guard.

Fields.Name: Knockback: Airborne Distance Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier on knockback distance when hit in the air. While guarding, it is applied on top of the guard multiplier.

Fields.Name: Blade Homing: Model Pitch Speed
Fields.Description: Default angular speed of the model's up/down rotation during blade homing. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Ricochet: Minimum Incidence Angle
Fields.Description: Only bullets with an incidence angle of this value or more ricochet. 0 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: Ricochet: Chance
Fields.Description: Chance of a ricochet, as a percentage.

Fields.Name: Ricochet: Upward Angle Range
Fields.Description: Range of the random upward angle of a bullet after a ricochet. 0 to 90 degrees.

Fields.Name: Ricochet: Downward Angle Range
Fields.Description: Range of the random downward angle of a bullet after a ricochet. 0 to 90 degrees.

Fields.Name: Ricochet: Initial Original Direction Rate
Fields.Description: How close the bullet direction right after a ricochet is to its original direction. 0.0: straight along the shield surface. 1.0: same as before the ricochet.

Fields.Name: Ricochet: Final Original Direction Rate
Fields.Description: How close the final bullet direction after a ricochet is to its original direction. 0.0: straight along the shield surface. 1.0: same as before the ricochet.

Fields.Name: Ricochet: Direction Change Time
Fields.Description: Time for the bullet to move from its direction right after the ricochet to its final direction. In seconds.

Fields.Name: No Weapon Dummy Weapon ID
Fields.Description: Dummy weapon ID equipped when a slot other than the hands has no weapon.

Fields.Name: Aim: Lock Distance Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier that extends the lock distance (including secondary lock) while aiming.

Fields.Name: Blade Homing: Inertia Trigger Angle
Fields.Description: Angle used by the ChrBehavior condition "angle between target direction and horizontal movement direction is at or below the inertial blade homing angle". In degrees.

Fields.Name: Riding: Acceleration Rate
Fields.Description: Speed multiplier while riding a vehicle: normal speed x this value = vehicle speed.

Fields.Name: Riding: Slide Slope Angle
Fields.Description: Slope angle at which the vehicle starts to slide while riding. 0 to 90 degrees.

Fields.Name: Quick Turn: Rotation Angle
Fields.Description: How far a quick turn rotates. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Prediction Rate: No Reduction in Free Camera
Fields.Description: Whether the shot prediction rate is reduced while the camera is not fixed. 0: reduce. 1: do not reduce.

Fields.Name: Ricochet: Keep Impact Decay Timer
Fields.Description: Player AC. If ON, a ricochet does not reset the timer that speeds up accumulative impact decay.

Fields.Name: Quick Turn: Rotation Time
Fields.Description: Duration of a quick turn. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Quick Turn: Input Threshold
Fields.Description: Stick input amount needed to trigger a quick turn.

Fields.Name: Reverse Joint: Air QB Vertical Angle
Fields.Description: Reverse joint legs only. Additional vertical movement angle of an airborne Quick Boost. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Bare Hand Dummy Weapon ID
Fields.Description: Dummy weapon ID equipped when a hand has no weapon.

Fields.Name: Camera: Quick Turn Over-Shoulder Angle Rate
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate of the over-the-shoulder camera angle during a quick camera turn.

Fields.Name: Guard: Successful Guard Braking Time
Fields.Description: Time spent slowing down after a successful guard. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Guard: Successful Guard Speed Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier on speed after a successful guard. 0: speed becomes zero. 1: no change.

Fields.Name: Camera: Wall Check Minimum Head Height
Fields.Description: Camera wall collision checks use the AC's head height. During death animations this can get low enough to hit the ground, so this value sets a minimum. In metres.

Fields.Name: Air 180 Turn: Stop Speed
Fields.Description: During an airborne 180-degree turn, braking stops and the AC counts as stopped once the speed falls to this value or lower. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Target Marking: Out-of-Range Timeout
Fields.Description: Time before a marked target is forgotten after it leaves the range. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Round Dash: End Time
Fields.Description: A round dash (dashing around the target) ends after this time even if the goal position is not reached. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Round Dash: Goal Offset
Fields.Description: The round dash goal position is placed this far from the target's position. In metres.

Fields.Name: Round Dash: Start Angle
Fields.Description: The round dash starts moving in a direction offset by this angle from the target direction. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Round Dash: Goal Angle
Fields.Description: The round dash goal is set at this angle around the target, measured from the direction to the target. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Round Dash: Maximum Round Angle
Fields.Description: Up to this angle from the direction from the target, the initial round angle is used. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Round Dash: Straight Approach Angle
Fields.Description: Once the AC reaches this angle from the direction from the target, it moves straight to the goal position. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Round Dash: End Speed
Fields.Description: After reaching the goal angle, the round dash control ends once the speed falls to this value or lower. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Target Marking: Forget Distance
Fields.Description: The marking is removed when the target is this far away or more.

Fields.Name: Target Marking: Capture Distance
Fields.Description: Distance within which a target is marked. Used together with Target Marking: Capture Angle.

Fields.Name: Target Marking: Capture Angle
Fields.Description: Angle within which a target is marked. Used together with Target Marking: Capture Distance. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Mouse: Target Switch Wait Time
Fields.Description: Wait time between target switches made by moving the mouse. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Mouse: Target Switch Input Coefficient
Fields.Description: Coefficient that converts mouse input into target switch input. Intended to be mostly independent of mouse sensitivity.

Fields.Name: Blade Homing: Brake Time Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the duration of the blade homing brake.

Fields.Name: Blade Homing: Brake Decay Rate
Fields.Description: Decay coefficient of the blade homing brake over time.

Fields.Name: Blade Homing: Brake Target Speed
Fields.Description: Speed the blade homing brake slows the AC down to. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Brake Variation: Minimum Brake Rate
Fields.Description: Lowest brake rate the random brake variation can pick.

Fields.Name: Brake Variation: Maximum Brake Rate
Fields.Description: Highest brake rate the random brake variation can pick.

Fields.Name: Brake Variation: Minimum Reroll Interval
Fields.Description: Shortest interval between new random picks of the brake variation rate. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Brake Variation: Maximum Reroll Interval
Fields.Description: Longest interval between new random picks of the brake variation rate. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Stunlock Escape Value
Fields.Description: Point value at which the AC breaks out of a stunlock (being hit repeatedly without being able to act).

Fields.Name: Camera: Quick Turn Horizontal Follow Rate
Fields.Description: Horizontal character follow rate during a quick camera turn (0.0 to 1.0), used to keep the turn centred on the AC. Negative: do not override.

Fields.Name: Camera: Quick Turn Follow Rate Interpolation
Fields.Description: Interpolation rate of the horizontal character follow rate during a quick camera turn (0.0 to 1.0). Negative: do not override.

Fields.Name: Turn Foot Particle: Minimum Turn Speed
Fields.Description: Foot particle effect while turning. Above this turn speed, the turn rate starts to rise. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Turn Foot Particle: Maximum Turn Speed
Fields.Description: Foot particle effect while turning. At this turn speed or more, the turn rate is at its maximum. In degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Turn Foot Particle: Particle ID
Fields.Description: Particle effect ID played at the feet while turning.

Fields.Name: Turn Foot Particle: Minimum Brake Rate
Fields.Description: Foot particle effect while turning: minimum brake rate.

Fields.Name: Turn Foot Particle: Minimum Speed
Fields.Description: Foot particle effect while turning. Above this speed, the speed rate starts to rise. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Turn Foot Particle: Maximum Speed
Fields.Description: Foot particle effect while turning. At this speed or more, the speed rate is at its maximum. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Stowed Weapon Attach Dummy Poly ID: Left
Fields.Description: Dummy poly ID (including offset) a weapon attaches to when stowed on the left side. Only used when enabled for debugging.

Fields.Name: Stowed Weapon Attach Dummy Poly ID: Right
Fields.Description: Dummy poly ID (including offset) a weapon attaches to when stowed on the right side. Only used when enabled for debugging.

Fields.Name: Boost Move: Jumpable Height
Fields.Description: Height above the ground at which a jump is still allowed when the AC lifts off unexpectedly while boosting.

Fields.Name: Broken Part: Forced Physics Time
Fields.Description: Time after a part model breaks during which physics is always active. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Broken Part: Physics Stop Time
Fields.Description: Time after a part model breaks before its physics is forcibly stopped. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Heavy Weapon Additive Anim ID: Right Hand
Fields.Description: Animation ID of the heavyweight additive animation for the right hand.

Fields.Name: Heavy Weapon Additive Anim ID: Left Hand
Fields.Description: Animation ID of the heavyweight additive animation for the left hand.

Fields.Name: Slope Waist Tilt (Boost): Maximum Speed
Fields.Description: Waist tilt on slopes while boosting. Speed at which the waist swing is greatest. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Slope Waist Tilt (Boost): Stopped Tilt Rate
Fields.Description: Waist tilt on slopes while boosting. Tilt rate when stopped.

Fields.Name: Slope Waist Tilt (Boost): Max Speed Tilt Rate
Fields.Description: Waist tilt on slopes while boosting. Tilt rate at the maximum speed.

Fields.Name: Slope Waist Tilt (Boost): Stopped Blend Rate
Fields.Description: Waist tilt on slopes while boosting. Blend rate when stopped; the waist tilts toward the target by this rate every frame.

Fields.Name: Slope Waist Tilt (Boost): Max Speed Blend Rate
Fields.Description: Waist tilt on slopes while boosting. Blend rate at the maximum speed; the waist tilts toward the target by this rate every frame.

Fields.Name: Air Shooting: LookAt Start Height
Fields.Description: Height at which the body starts to tilt when shooting in the air. In metres.

Fields.Name: Air Shooting: LookAt Full Tilt Distance
Fields.Description: Height the AC must move after the tilt starts for the air shooting tilt to reach its maximum. In metres.

Fields.Name: Behaviour: Shoot Standby After Target Lost
Fields.Description: How long shooting standby is kept after the lock target disappears, so the animation does not flicker when the target comes and goes. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Lock: Post-Kill Selection Range (Near)
Fields.Description: Normal lock, target selection after defeating an enemy. Enemies in view within this range are preferred, and enemies behind can also be selected. In metres.

Fields.Name: Lock: Post-Kill Selection Range (Far)
Fields.Description: Normal lock, target selection after defeating an enemy. Enemies beyond this range are not selected. In metres.

Fields.Name: Lock: Manual Switch Selection Angle
Fields.Description: Normal lock. Selection angle for manual target switching, measured on one side from the AC. 90 covers the front, 180 the full circle. 0 to 180 degrees.

Fields.Name: Lock: Back Switch Range
Fields.Description: Normal lock. Range around the AC within which the target can also be switched to an enemy behind. In metres.

Fields.Name: Camera: Z Tilt Interpolation Slow Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier applied to Camera: Z Tilt Interpolation Frames.

Fields.Name: Camera: Z Tilt End Interpolation Slow Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier applied to Camera: Z Tilt End Interpolation Frames.

Fields.Name: Overhead Check Ray Length
Fields.Description: Length of the raycast that checks for objects above the AC. In metres.

Fields.Name: Overhead Check Interval
Fields.Description: Interval between checks for objects above the AC. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Barrier Hit: Bullet Speed Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier applied to a bullet's speed when it hits a barrier.

Fields.Name: Barrier Hit: Bullet Minimum Speed
Fields.Description: Minimum bullet speed after hitting a barrier. In metres per second.

Fields.Name: Barrier Hit: Bullet Maximum Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum bullet speed after hitting a barrier. In metres per second. 0: no limit.

Fields.Name: Missile Lock: Multi-Lock Hold Time
